description: Velocidad promedio vehicular en las principales avenidas de Montevideo is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Montevideo. El sistema de conteo vehicular que utiliza el Centro de Gestión de Movilidad (CGM) para la medición de los volúmenes vehiculares y velocidades promedio que circulan por las arterias que se encuentran centralizadas, utiliza analíticas de video para la generación de los datos necesarios para la elaboración de planes y coordinaciones semafóricas. Coverage: Intendencia de Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Montevideo. Its tags are Harvest, Movilidad, Tránsito, Vehículos. It offers 70 resource(s) in CSV, CSV ZIP, TXT. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
